title: The Moat
blurb: The sihek, or Guam kingfisher, is Extinct in the Wild. Plotting every kingfisher ND2 sequence in GenBank by its distance from this one bird reveals a ring 2.02 percentage points wide containing nothing at all. The chart inks the emptiness and leaves the data as dust.

title: The Wrong Kind of Sign
blurb: Gibson's Neuromancer coded line by line against Peirce's theory of the sign. Five machines in the book hold fluent conversation and every one of them is ignored; 217 coded passages say why. Fluency reads as resemblance, never as cause, and resemblance licenses no inference to a mind. A blind second coder then refuted the author.
